mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.FORMSTYLE, B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, B.EDITMONITORINFO, B.SAMPLEORGID, C.ORGNAME AS REPORTORGNAME, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'cancel' THEN '终止' ELSE '正常' END CANCELSTATUS FROM T_EMC_PROJECT_CHANGE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON A.REPORTORGID = C.ID) T
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done'
AND ( INSTR( ',' || SAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0 OR F.SCENEUSERID = #{sampleUserId}) ) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A WHERE A.PROJID = T.ID AND A.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'draft%' AND A.STATUS = 'draft') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done' AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID='') ))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'approve')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done'
AND (INSTR( ',' || SAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0 OR F.SCENEUSERID = #{sampleUserId}) ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A WHERE A.PROJID = T.ID AND A.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'draft%' AND A.STATUS = 'logged')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'logged' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND (O.RUNID IS NULL or O.RUNID=''))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O, T_EMC_SUBCONTRACT_RECORD S WHERE O.ID = S.ORDERTASKID AND O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.DATASHARING = '1')
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJ_SCHEME PS WHERE PS.PROJID = T.ID AND PS.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId}))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER R LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT_CHANGE M ON R.PROJID = M.ID WHERE R.PROCESSSTATUS='done' AND M.STATUS <> 'cancel' AND R.STATUS = #{folderStatus} AND R.PROJID=T.ID )
AND T.STATUS <> 'cancel'
AND T.SOURCE IS NULL OR T.SOURCE = ''
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID=T.ID AND O.SAMPLEBEGINDATE >= #{samplingStartDate} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID=T.ID AND O.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE <= #{samplingEndDate} )
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT A.*, B.FORMSTYLE, B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, B.EDITMONITORINFO, C.ORGNAME AS REPORTORGNAME FROM T_EMC_PROJECT_CHANGE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON A.REPORTORGID = C.ID WHERE A.ID = #{id}

SELECT B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, COUNT(*) AS projectCount FROM T_EMC_PROJECT_CHANGE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID
GROUP BY B.BIZCATEGORYNAME ORDER BY
B.BIZCATEGORYNAME ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TASKDATE, '%m') AS monthValue, COUNT(*) AS projectCount FROM T_EMC_PROJECT_CHANGE A
AND DATE_FORMAT(TASKDATE, '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y')
GROUP BY monthValue ORDER BY monthValue

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, B.EDITMONITORINFO, C.ORDERCATEGORY, C.MONITORTMPLID FROM T_EMC_PROJECT_CHANGE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_REPORT C ON A.ID = C.PROJID) T
AND
AND T.STATUS = 'auditFinished' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER F LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT ON F.ID = OT.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN R ON OT.RUNID = R.ID WHERE F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.ORDERCATEGORY = T.ORDERCATEGORY AND OT.STATUS = 'audit' AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis')
AND T.STATUS = 'auditFinished' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER F LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT ON F.ID = OT.FOLDERID WHERE F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.ORDERCATEGORY = T.ORDERCATEGORY AND OT.STATUS = 'audit' AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND (T.REPORTEDITUSERID = #{reportEditUserId} OR T.REPORTEDITUSERID IS NULL))
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
